news.title: Demant A/S: Opjusterede forventninger til 2026 og genoptagelse af aktietilbagekøb
Bernstein unveils top European medtech stock picks to buy for H2
news.summary: Investing.com -- European medtech has had another bruising year, with only Demant and Sonova outperforming the Stoxx 600 in 2026 as the sector’s once-premium valuation continues to de-rate.
